data.value: The restore could not be prepared: {0}. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Backup_RestoredToast
data.value: Restored the backup from {0}. A safety backup of the previous state is in Backups.

data.name: Backup_RolledBackToast
data.value: The restore did not complete, so your previous data was put back unchanged. Details are in the log.

data.name: Backup_ErrNotArchive

data.name: Backup_ErrUnreadable

data.value: This is not an Arcadia backup (the manifest is missing or unreadable).

data.name: Diag_ResetSettingsHint
data.value: Restores default preferences and restarts Arcadia. Your library, media, backups, saved API keys and data-folder choice are kept; the old settings are saved as settings.before-reset.json.

data.name: Welcome_Body
data.value: Games, projects, documents, travel, calendar, tasks, notes and finances — one quiet, fast place on your own PC. Five short questions and you are in; everything can be changed later in Settings.

data.name: Welcome_Private
data.value: Arcadia has no account and no cloud. Your library stays on this computer; nothing is uploaded, and online lookups (weather, map tiles, artwork) only happen where you see them.

data.name: Welcome_LanguageHint
data.value: You can switch at any time in Settings.

data.name: Welcome_ArabicNote
data.value: Right-to-left layout; paths, code and numbers stay left-to-right.

data.name: Welcome_DataHint
data.value: The database, Arcadia's media, logs and caches live in this folder. Files you add to projects and documents stay where they are — Arcadia only references them.

data.name: Welcome_DataNote
data.value: Uninstalling Arcadia never deletes this folder.

data.name: Welcome_PerfHint
data.value: Gaming Mode always takes over while a game runs: Arcadia goes quiet and pauses background work.

data.name: Welcome_PerfAutoHint
data.value: Full experience; saves power on battery. Recommended.

data.name: Welcome_PerfSaverHint
data.value: Fewer animations, background indexing paused. For older or quiet machines.

data.name: Welcome_StartupHint
data.value: Optional. Arcadia then starts in the notification area so reminders, play tracking and automations are ready.

data.name: Welcome_StartWithWindows
data.value: Start Arcadia when I sign in

data.name: Welcome_StartWithWindowsHint
data.value: Starts minimized; you can turn this off in Settings → Windows & performance.

data.name: Welcome_Ready
data.value: That's everything. Arcadia starts with an empty library — add a game, a project or a note and it becomes yours.

data.name: Home_EmptyBody
data.value: Add a game to the library and Arcadia keeps its play sessions, progress, screenshots and notes. The rest of Home fills up as you use Arcadia.
